cohort: The study compared 134 pregnant women with diabetes mellitus (n=35) or gestational diabetes (n=99) complicated by preterm premature rupture of membranes (PPROM) with 135 normoglycemic pregnant women also complicated by PPROM.
finding: Maternal hospital stay and the duration of vaginal delivery were significantly shorter in normoglycemic controls, and neonatal hypoglycemia was significantly higher in the diabetes mellitus group, while other maternal, fetal, and neonatal outcomes were comparable across groups.
mod_finding: The duration of vaginal delivery was significantly shorter in normoglycemic controls compared to patients with gestational diabetes, while the incidence of cesarean section was comparable across all groups.
